Endocrinology consultation to confirm the diagnostic category from the T-scores and FRAX, the risk category, the choice of drug, the secondary-causes work-up, and the plan for monitoring and treatment duration. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, osteoporosis monograph (2026); The clinician's guide to prevention and treatment of osteoporosis (2022); American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists/American College of Endocrinology Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis, 2020 Update (2020); Pharmacological Management of Osteoporosis in Postmenopausal Women: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline (2019) [S]

Calcium about 1200 mg a day in total, from food first, and vitamin D3 1971 units a day to reach 30 ng/mL or more, then continue; caffeine kept to two cups of coffee a day; no tobacco or alcohol. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, osteoporosis monograph (2026); The clinician's guide to prevention and treatment of osteoporosis (2022); American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists/American College of Endocrinology Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis, 2020 Update (2020) [S]

Falls prevention by CDC STEADI: supervised balance and strength exercise with a physical therapist for eight weeks, then a home program three times a week; weight-bearing exercise most days; home safety review (stair rails, night lights, no loose rugs); low-heeled shoes when traveling; yearly vision check. Guideline: The clinician's guide to prevention and treatment of osteoporosis (2022); Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions (2024); STEADI: Stopping Elderly Accidents, Deaths, and Injuries (2026) [S]

Monitoring on the CMID osteoporosis schedule: secondary-causes tests at baseline (calcium, albumin, phosphate, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase, creatinine and eGFR, PTH, 25-hydroxyvitamin D, TSH, blood count, and 24-hour urine calcium); calcium and creatinine before each infusion; fasting CTX at baseline and three to six months after starting; 25-hydroxyvitamin D after repletion and then yearly; height and fall-risk screen yearly; FRAX recalculated when risk factors change; DXA of the spine and hip two years after starting, on the same scanner. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, osteoporosis monograph (2026); American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists/American College of Endocrinology Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis, 2020 Update (2020); Pharmacological Management of Osteoporosis in Postmenopausal Women: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline (2019); Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures: Screening (2025) [S]

Recovery-oriented care for alcohol use disorder in sustained remission: ask about alcohol, cravings, and stress at each visit in a non-judgmental way, support the recovery practices she uses, avoid sedating medicines, and review safety with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at each visit. Guideline: CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, osteoporosis monograph (2026); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Substance Use Disorders (2021); VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide (2024) [S]
